title: Delta and omicron flight configurations of the craft

tellings.quote: When all three of the amplifiers are being used for travel, they're in the delta configuration. And when only one is being used for travel, it's in the omicron configuration.

plain: The craft he studied had two ways of flying: with all three of its amplifiers, the parts that drive it, used for travel it was in "the delta configuration," and with only one used it was in "the omicron configuration." Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft from 1987 to 1989 at S-4, a secret site in Nevada, describes this from what he says he learned firsthand. If true, it would be an inside account of how such a craft is flown.
